description: 通过天眼查 MCP 查询企业工商、股权、风险、司法、投资和知识产权数据。

steps: 天眼查 MCP 使用 OAuth 2.0 和 PKCE S256。
运行时会动态注册名为“联通数智”的客户端，并打开天眼查返回的授权页。
完成登录授权后，凭据仅保存在本地并用于天眼查 MCP。

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Tianyancha MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the live schema first, then call the matching tool.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by Tianyancha MCP discovery.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the current inputSchema for the selected Eastmoney MCP tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Tianyancha MCP tool.

result.description: The current Eastmoney MCP result after standard MCP content normalization.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Tianyancha MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: List the current tool catalog and live input schemas exposed by Tianyancha MCP.

inputSchema.description: Input for discovering Tianyancha MCP tools.

name.description: The exact Tianyancha MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Tianyancha.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether Eastmoney expects the tool not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether Eastmoney indicates that the tool may be destructive.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with external entities.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Eastmoney for a tool.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Tianyancha MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by Tianyancha MCP.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by Tianyancha MCP.

outputSchema.description: The current Eastmoney MCP tool catalog.
